message: Fixed and verified. Everyone is square for the Lisbon trip after $100.00 shared.

plan.title: Bug Reproduction - Lisbon trip $100/3 rounding leaves $0.01 balance after Settle up
plan.url: 127.0.0.1:5174  [shown in browser address bar as `127.0.0.1:5174` / `Lisbon trip - Tally`]
plan.expected:
After adding $100 expense paid by Alex split 3-ways AND clicking `Settle up`:
* Balances should all be $0.00 - `Alex is owed $0.00` / `Sam owes nothing` / `Jo owes nothing` or `All settled up`.
* `TOTAL SPENT` remains $100.00.
* Two settle-up transactions of $33.33 should fully settle the debt with rounding handled, leaving 0 cent remaining.
plan.actual:
32.3s video - Lisbon trip expense splitter `Tally` 
Video shows fresh load of group `Lisbon trip - Alex, Sam and Jo | Oct 24 - Oct 30`

Address bar visible throughout: `127.0.0.1:5174` / `127.0.0.1:5174/Lisbon trip - Tally` - `http://127.0.0.1:5174`

steps.instruction: [00:00] Fresh page load / Navigate to Lisbon trip group. App shows `Lisbon trip` header with members Alex, Sam + Jo.

steps.target: `Add expense > Description` input [placeholder: `e.g. Dinner at Taberna`]

steps.instruction: [00:11-00:13] Leave `Paid by` as `Alex` [default] and `Split equally between everyone` [default - split 3 ways]

[00:14-00:22] Observe `Expenses` now shows `1 expense - Dinner - Alex paid - split 3 ways - $100.00`. `TOTAL SPENT $100.00`. `Balances` shows `Alex is owed $66.67`, `Sam owes $33.33`, `Jo owes $33.33`. `SUGGESTED PAYMENTS: Sam pays Alex $33.33, Jo pays Alex $33.33`
[00:22-00:24] Click `Settle up` button [purple, bottom of Balances panel]

before.evidence: Balances shows 'Alex is owed $0.01' with 'Sam owes nothing' and 'Jo owes nothing', Expenses shows 'Dinner Alex paid - split 3 ways $100.00' plus two 'Settle up payment $33.33' (Jo paid Alex, Sam paid Alex), TOTAL SPENT $100.00

fix.root_cause: `splitEvenly` rounded every share with `Math.round`, so three $33.33 shares summed to $99.99 and left a 1-cent imbalance that settle-up payments could never clear.
fix.summary: Split into floored base shares with leftover cents dealt one each to the first members so shares always sum to the expense total.
fix.message: Fixed by muse-code; tests pass and the regression test fails on the old code.

after.evidence: AFTER Balances shows 'Alex owes nothing', 'Sam owes nothing', 'Jo owes nothing' plus 'All settled up Everyone is square. Nice trip!' with TOTAL SPENT $100.00 and two $33.33 settle payments, versus BEFORE 'Alex is owed $0.01' with Settle up button still visible
